chunks: He said: Abu Ghalib Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Zarari reported to me from Abul Qasim, Humaid ibn Ziyad, who reported from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad, who reported from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Attar, from his father al-Hasan ibn Ziyad who said:

When Zaid ibn Ali advanced upon Kufa, some reservation entered my heart about it. He said: So I went out to Makkah and passed by Madinah, and I entered upon Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, who was ill. I found him lying on his bed with nothing left between his skin and his bones. I said: 'I wish to present before you my creed.' He turned on his side, then looked at me and said: 'O Hasan, I always thought that you did not need this anymore.' Then he said: 'Proceed.' So I said: 'I testify that there is no god but God, and I testify that Muhammad is the messenger of God.' He, peace be upon him, said: 'The same with me also.' Then I said: 'And I confirm the truth of all that Muhammad ibn Abdillah, may God bless him and his family, brought.' He kept silent.

I said: 'And I testify that Ali is the Imam after the Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family, and obedience to him is obligatory. Whoever doubts about him is gone astray, and whoever denies him is an unbeliever.' He kept silent. I said: 'And I testify that al-Hasan and al-Husayn, peace be upon them, have the same position,' and I continued till I reached him, peace be upon him, and I said: 'And I testify that you are in the same position as al-Hasan and al-Husayn and the Imams preceding you.' He said: 'Enough. You know exactly what you want. You only want me to give you my undertaking on this.' I said: 'If you give me your undertaking on this, then I have fulfilled my desire.' He said: 'I give you my undertaking over it.'

I said: 'May I be your ransom, I was thinking of staying.' He said: 'Why?' I said: 'If Zaid and his companions win, then we would be in the worst situation with them. And if Banu Umayya win, we would be in the same position with them.' He said to me: 'Go, no harm will come to you from either side.'

key_terms.إمام: Imam — divinely appointed leader of the Muslim community after the Prophet
key_terms.تولى: To give an undertaking, to accept authority over someone's religious allegiance
key_terms.دين: Creed, religion, faith — here used in the sense of presenting one's doctrinal beliefs for confirmation
key_terms.منزلة: Position, station, rank — referring to the equal spiritual authority of each Imam

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about Zaid ibn Ali's revolt?
ai.summary: Al-Hasan ibn Ziyad visited Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) during the period of Zaid ibn Ali's revolt in Kufa (122 AH). Despite the Imam's severe illness, al-Hasan presented his articles of faith one by one, from the shahada through the imamate of Ali, al-Hasan, al-Husayn, and the successive Imams. The Imam accepted his creed and reassured him of safety regardless of the revolt's outcome, affirming the Shia quietist position that divine guardianship (wilaya) is distinct from political uprising.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 6. He said: Abu Ghalib Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Zarari reported to me from Abul Qasim, Hamid ibn Ziyad, who reported from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad, who reported from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ziyad al-Attar, from his father al-Hasan ibn Ziyad who said:

When Zaid ibn ‘Ali advanced upon Kufa, some reservation entered my mind about it. He says: Then I went to Makkah, and passed by Madinah to call upon Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, who was then ill. I found him lying prone on his bed, with nothing left between his skin and the bones. I said: "I wish to assert before you my creed." He turned on his side, and looking at me, said: "O Hasan, I always thought that you did not need this anymore." Then he said: "Proceed." So I said: "I testify that there is no god but Allah, and I testify that Muhammad is the messenger of Allah." He, peace be upon him, said: "The same with me, also." Then I said: "I confirm the truth of all that Muhammad ibn Abdillah came with." He kept silent.

Then I said: "And I testify that ‘Ali is the Imam after the Prophet, and obedience to him is obligatory. Whoever doubts about him is gone astray, and whoever disputes his authority is an unbeliever." He kept silent. Then I said: "I testify that al-Hasan and al-Husayn, peace be upon them, have the same position (as ‘Ali)", and then I continued till I reached his name, and said: "And I testify that you are in the same position as al-Hasan and al-Husayn and the Imams preceding you." He said: "Enough. You know exactly what you wish, you wish me to give my undertaking on this?" I said: "If you do so, then I will have fulfilled my desire." He said: "I give you my undertaking over it."

I said: "May I be your ransom, I was worried about the uprising." He said: "Why?" I said: "Because if Zaid and his companions won the battle, then we would have been in the worst situation. And if Banu Umayya won, we would have been no better." He said: "Go, no harm will reach you from either."
